name: Closin (Closin Distribuidora LTDA)
summary: Brazilian filament distributor based in Chapeco, Santa Catarina, founded 2019 (CNPJ 58.506.101/0001-19). Imports filament from audited overseas suppliers through its own sourcing office in China and sells under the Closin label, with PETG as the headline material. It is a distributor, not an extruder.

product_lines.name: Closin TPU
product_lines.notes: Flexible TPU; no shore hardness published, so the generic id is used.

product_lines.name: Closin DUO
product_lines.notes: Dual-colour filament; mapped to pla-gradient as the nearest colour-varying id.

additional_notes: Pricing roughly USD 12-17/kg equivalent. Closin describes its sourcing as coming from audited overseas suppliers via a Chinese sourcing office but does not name any of them, so no OEM relationship can be recorded and manufacturing_countries is empty - the filament is imported, and Brazil is the country of sale, not of manufacture.

provenance.conflicts: Suppliers are described as 'audited' but none is named; country of origin for each line is therefore unconfirmed, though China is the likely source given the stated sourcing office.
